h1: The 5 Best TV Stands with Mount of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best TV Stands with Mount: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five TV stands with a built-in mount bracket, compared on TV size, VESA support, weight limits and storage so the fit is right.
summary: The FITUEYES swivel floor stand is the best overall for 32 to 70 inch TVs. The MJOMKN suits people who need built-in power and drawers, the Mount-It! MI-864 is the glass-shelf value pick, and the Universal Corner stand and FITUEYES Wood stand cover small rooms.
intro: The built-in bracket is the part buyers check last and regret first. If your TV's VESA pattern is outside the bracket's range, or the TV weighs more than the mount's rating, the stand is a very expensive shelf.
We ranked five stands that include a mount, using the spec sheets for TV size, VESA range, load limits and storage. Every pick below names its range so you can match your own TV before you order.

products.name: FITUEYES TV Stand with Mount for 32-70 inch TVs, Swivel Floor Entertainment Center
products.verdict: The widest TV range, with swivel and shelf capacity.
products.description:
This FITUEYES stand fits 32 to 70 inch TVs with VESA patterns from 200x200 to 600x400. The mount holds up to 110 lbs, swivels 25 degrees each way and has 2 height levels, while the shelves are rated 33, 33 and 55 lbs.

It ranks first because its TV range and weight limit are the highest here. The MJOMKN below swivels further and adds power, but its listing gives no weight limit.

Buy it for a large TV in a living room. It costs $100-200.

products.name: MJOMKN TV Stand with Mount and Power Outlet, Swivel LED Lights for 32-70 Inch TVs
products.verdict: Power strip, drawers and a wide swivel in one unit.
products.description:
The MJOMKN fits 32 to 70 inch TVs, swivels 34 degrees each way and offers 3 height positions. It has a built-in power strip with 4 AC and 2 USB outlets, plus 3 storage drawers and shelves, and anti-tip straps come in the box.

It ranks second because the listing gives no mount weight rating, unlike the FITUEYES. The power strip and drawers are the reason to choose it.

It suits people with many devices to plug in. Check your TV's weight against the product page.
products.skipIf: You need a stated weight limit.

products.name: Mount-It! TV Stand with Mount and Storage Shelves MI-864, Fits 32-60 Inch Screens
products.verdict: Glass shelves and a wide VESA range for $50-100.
products.description:
The MI-864 fits 32 to 60 inch screens with VESA from 75x75 to 600x400 and holds up to 88 lbs. It has 3 tempered glass shelves, an aluminum powder-coated frame and a built-in cable channel.

It ranks third because the TV size tops out at 60 inches and the weight limit is lower than the top pick. The VESA range starts at 75x75, which is the widest in this ranking.

Choose it for a mid-size TV on a budget.

products.name: FITUEYES Wood TV Stand with Mount for 32-55 inch TVs, 2 Tier Entertainment Center
products.verdict: A warmer wood look for smaller TVs.
products.description:
The wood FITUEYES fits 32 to 55 inch TVs with VESA 100x100 to 400x400. Max load is 77 lbs, it has 3 height levels and two removable wood shelves in a golden walnut finish.

It ranks fourth because it supports a smaller range of TVs than the steel FITUEYES above. It looks like furniture rather than a rack.

Buy it for a bedroom or small living room where look matters.
products.skipIf: You own a 60 inch or larger TV.

products.name: Universal Floor Small Corner TV Stand with Mount, 23-50 inch TVs
products.verdict: A corner-friendly rack for small TVs.
products.description:
This corner stand fits 23 to 50 inch TVs, with a TV rack rated to 80 lbs and mesh shelves rated to 40 lbs each. The bracket adjusts from 3.5 to 18.9 inches wide, there are 3 open shelves and the feet are adjustable rubber.

It ranks last because it supports the smallest TVs here. It is the one that tucks into a corner.

Pick it for a dorm or small apartment with a 50 inch or smaller TV.

whatMatters.detail: VESA is the hole pattern on the back of your TV, measured in millimeters. The bracket must cover it or the TV will not bolt on. Find your TV's pattern in its manual and compare it with the range in the title or bullets.
The mount has a load limit separate from the shelves. A 110 lb mount gives headroom for a large TV, while a 77 lb one is tighter. Look for a stated lbs figure.
A stand rated for 32 to 70 inches is not the same as one rated for 23 to 50. Check the maximum, and leave margin if you may upgrade.
Swivel lets you angle the screen toward a sofa, and height levels match your seating. A 25 or 34 degree swivel is useful in open rooms. The spec bullets list both.
A tall mount makes a stand top-heavy. Anti-tip hardware and wide bases help. Check whether straps are included, as with the MJOMKN.

faq.q: Will any TV fit a built-in mount?
faq.a: No. Check the VESA pattern and weight against the stand. The Mount-It! MI-864 covers 75x75 to 600x400.

faq.q: What if my TV is heavier than the mount rating?
faq.a: Do not use the stand. Choose one with a higher rating, such as the 110 lb FITUEYES 32-70.

faq.q: Is the MJOMKN worth it over the FITUEYES?
faq.a: If you need built-in power and drawers, yes. If a stated weight limit matters more, the FITUEYES is safer.

faq.q: How do I set up a floor stand?
faq.a: Assemble on a flat floor, attach the bracket to the TV first, then lift both onto the stand with a helper.

faq.q: Should I use the anti-tip hardware?
faq.a: Yes. It matters most in homes with kids or pets, and the MJOMKN includes straps.

faq.q: Can I put a soundbar on these?
faq.a: Often yes, on the shelves. Check the shelf ratings, like 33 or 55 lbs on the FITUEYES.

finalTake: The FITUEYES 32-70 stand is the best pick for most people with a large TV. The MJOMKN is the best if you need power outlets and drawers, and the Mount-It! MI-864 is the value choice. Small rooms should look at the Universal Corner stand or the FITUEYES Wood stand.
